items.title: Your Characters, Kept Safe
items.body: Your characters now live on the server, not on your PC: sign in on any computer and they are there. Every name is one of a kind across the whole game. If someone took your name first, character select asks you to pick a new one before you play.

items.title: Callouts Have a Beat
items.body: Step into a Callout in town and the fight music kicks in. Press an attack skill right on the beat and that hit lands 6 % harder. Find the rhythm and out-hit your rival.

items.title: Saves You Can Trust
items.body: Every trade, Kiosk sale and Crew founding now saves in one go: if anything goes wrong, nothing is left half-done and nothing is lost. Your progress is kept by the server's own database, backed up regularly.

items.title: A Launcher With an Edge
items.body: The launcher has a new angular comic frame, cleaner panels and a sharper PLAY button. The painting slideshow, this news and the past news are right where they were.

items.title: Walk the Walls
items.body: Zone01's buildings and cliffs are ground now. Run straight up a wall onto the roof, leap from wall to wall, and hold on with Grip (it spends Flux while you cling). Fights follow you up there: strike round corners, chase along a face, and leave ground-bound creatures snapping below.

items.title: Two-Hit Attacks
items.body: Every class has a two-hit attack on Hotbar T, with 18 new two-hit Skill Chips to collect. Redline lands harder on the beat, Stances are shared with your Squad, and Wallstride carries you up and over anything 2.2 m tall.

items.title: Instant Response Online
items.body: On a server your character now moves, jumps and casts the moment you press, instead of waiting for the server to answer. Jumps wind up with a crackle of sparks, vaults flow straight into your run, and your pet does the same tricks on every screen.

items.title: Autopilot Passes & Loadouts
items.body: Autopilot comes as a 3, 14 or 30-day Pass. Save whole gear sets as Loadouts and swap in one click. A step picker sits beside every + for quick counts, the Armorer stocks one of each forge material a week, and your portrait shows the colours you wear.

items.title: Real Servers
items.body: Krytical Nova runs on its own dedicated server. Pick one in the Servers window, or press Enter on the title to join the last one you played on. Your characters and everything they own are saved on the server, and friends outside your house can join too.

items.title: This Launcher
items.body: One small launcher keeps the game up to date. It downloads only the files that changed, checks every file against a signed list so nothing can be slipped in, and repairs a broken install with one click.

items.title: Game Masters
items.body: Each server has up to three Game Masters, marked [GM] in chat and over their heads, with a GM chat channel and a GM console of their own to help players and run events.

items.title: A New Opening
items.body: The game opens with the studio crest and the Krytical Nova logo with a glitch, and the cover painting is now the title screen in every faction's skin.

items.title: The Flask
items.body: A refillable Flux reservoir on your potion bar. Buy one from the Apothecary or find one on Hostiles, and top up your Flux in the middle of a fight.

items.title: Stims in Three Sizes
items.body: Every Stim now comes in Small, Medium and Large, so you choose how much to heal for how much it costs. All three are on the Apothecary's shelf.

items.title: The Recall Tag
items.body: Use a Recall Tag from your Pack or Hotbar, hold still for five seconds, and you are back in town wherever you were. Sold by the Apothecary.

history.label: 10 to 12 Oct 2026 · Style, pets & Crew Halls

items.title: Holoweave
items.body: Wear any look you have unlocked over the gear you have on, shared by every character on your account, and dye each piece in your own colours. Weapons take dye on every part, and Morphweave changes your pet's look.

items.title: Pets That Grow
items.body: Four pets with models of their own follow you and play little tricks. The Tidecaller hatches from an egg and grows at 25, 50, 75 and 100 %, and the Emberwing takes to the air beside you.

items.title: Crew Halls
items.body: Every Crew has a hall of its own: a private three-floor home to fit out with Facades and Finishes, built from solid pieces.

items.title: The Apothecary & Armorer
items.body: The first shops are open. The Apothecary sells Stims and Pet Rations; the Armorer sells Common gear and forge materials and runs the forge. Both buy what you sell, and ask first before taking anything Rare or better.

items.title: Three Factions
items.body: Choose the Hegemony, the Null or the Covenant, shape your character in the creator, and play with a HUD in your faction's own skin. Other factions are fair game; your own only in a duel.

items.title: The Forge
items.body: Temper, Fuse, Tune and Reforge your gear at the forge. Luck tips the odds, and as a piece climbs it lights up with a glow round its edge, up to Epic flame and lightning.

items.title: Creds, Trade & Kiosks
items.body: Earn Creds, keep them safe in your Vault, trade face to face with other players, and set up a Kiosk that keeps selling while you are away.

items.title: Squads, Crews & Duels
items.body: Form a Squad of up to five, keep your friends in Contacts, found a Crew, and settle a score with a duel to the death.
